name: ConvertNumberToTextNode
label: Convert Number to Text
description: Converts a numeric value into text with specified formatting options.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: NumberToConvert
fields.label: Number to Convert
fields.description: The numeric value to convert to text.

fields.name: DecimalPlaces
fields.label: Decimal Places
fields.description: The number of decimal places to include in the formatted text.

fields.name: UseThousandsSeparator
fields.label: Use Thousands Separator
fields.description: If true, includes a thousands separator in the formatted text.

fields.name: FormattedNumber
fields.label: Formatted Number
fields.description: The resulting formatted number as text.
